title: American Football
description: Test your knowledge of the NFL and gridiron!

questions.question: How many points is a touchdown worth?
questions.explanation: A touchdown is worth 6 points, with the option of a 1-point PAT or 2-point conversion.

questions.question: Which team has won the most Super Bowls?
questions.explanation: Both the Pittsburgh Steelers and New England Patriots have 6 Super Bowl wins each.

questions.question: Tom Brady has won 7 Super Bowl titles as a quarterback.
questions.explanation: Brady won 6 with the Patriots and 1 with the Buccaneers, the most by any player.

questions.question: How many players from one team are on the field at one time?
questions.explanation: Each NFL team fields 11 players at a time, on both offense and defense.

questions.question: What is a 'safety' worth in football?
questions.explanation: A safety is worth 2 points and occurs when the offense is tackled in their own end zone.

questions.question: The NFL season originally started in 1920 as the APFA.
questions.explanation: The American Professional Football Association (APFA) was founded in 1920 and renamed the NFL in 1922.

questions.question: How many yards must an offense gain for a first down?
questions.explanation: Offenses get four downs to gain 10 yards and earn a new set of downs.

questions.question: Which NFL position is responsible for snapping the ball to the quarterback?
questions.explanation: The center snaps the ball to begin each offensive play.

questions.question: Who holds the NFL record for career passing yards?
questions.explanation: Tom Brady retired as the all-time leader in passing yards with over 89,000.

questions.question: An NFL field is 100 yards long between the end zones.
questions.explanation: The playing field is 100 yards from goal line to goal line, plus 10-yard end zones on each end.
